correctness.rationale: The proof bounds each induced minimum-degree-three class in the 27-vertex ternary Hamming three-cube below by six vertices using the triangle-line clique structure and an odd-degree contradiction on five vertices. The explicit disjoint classes of sizes 9, 6, 6, 6 have minimum internal degrees 4, 3, 3, 3, so the maximum is exactly four. In all odd dimensions 2r+3, fixing one coordinate of each added coordinate pair preserves 3+2r same-colour neighbours out of total 2(2r+3). Direct standalone checks enumerate all 101,583 subsets of sizes one through five and verify construction for dimensions three, five, seven and nine. Computation is supplementary to the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 product paper identifies odd-dimensional Hamming graph majority C-colouring as open and has no improved odd-dimensional ternary construction. Determining the first nonbinary odd-dimensional case exactly is a natural missing exact invariant. The new base partition also gives an infinite family of stronger ternary lower bounds, a strict factor 4/3 improvement over the established general bound, with an explicit reproducible construction. The exact finite case and infinite lift form one connected claim rather than an arbitrary tiny numerical slice.
